correctness.rationale: A total endomorphism idempotent fixes its image pointwise; proper connected cycle images are induced arcs, and the complementary path must map via a bounded adjacent-step walk. This bijection proves exact rank counts and parity restrictions. Each proper arc has dihedral stabilizer of order two, acting on walks by reverse order with label complementation; the midpoint conditions yield F exactly, and orbit-stabilizer gives the complete class sizes. The independent brute-force checker directly enumerated all cases n=3..14 and compared all orbit histograms, but no finite test is treated as the proof.

value.rationale: Unit-conjugacy orbits of idempotents are a natural intrinsic invariant of finite transformation monoids and are strictly more informative than total idempotent counts, Green classes or simple rank sets. The result determines all orbit-size strata for every cycle, including a nontrivial reflection-fixed versus paired orbit dichotomy, providing a complete infinite-family classification rather than a narrow arbitrary finite sample.
